# Databricks notebook source
# MAGIC %md ## Feature Leakage Analysis

# COMMAND ----------

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# COMMAND ----------

# Read the data from workspace
df = pd.read_csv('/Workspace/Users/benedict@logicalclocks.com/mlpab115479/training_data.csv')

# Calculate correlation with label
correlations = df.corr()['label'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False)
print("Correlation with label (absolute value):")
print(correlations)
print()

# Check mean of each feature by label
for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4', 'f5', 'f6']:
    grouped = df.groupby('label')[col].mean()
    print(f"{col} mean by label: {grouped.to_dict()}")
    
# Also check if any feature perfectly predicts the label
for col in ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4', 'f5', 'f6']:
    # Check if feature values are different for each label
    label_0_values = df[df['label'] == 0][col]
    label_1_values = df[df['label'] == 1][col]
    print(f"\n{col} - Label 0: min={label_0_values.min():.3f}, max={label_0_values.max():.3f}, mean={label_0_values.mean():.3f}")
    print(f"{col} - Label 1: min={label_1_values.min():.3f}, max={label_1_values.max():.3f}, mean={label_1_values.mean():.3f}")
EOF
